chunks: When you come to the Euphrates, perform ghusl (ritual bath), put on your two pure garments, then go to the grave and say: “May Allah bless you, O Abā ʿAbdillāh; may Allah bless you, O Abā ʿAbdillāh; may Allah bless you, O Abā ʿAbdillāh.” Thus your visitation is completed in the state of taqiyyah.
That was narrated by Yūnus ibn Ẓabyān from al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام.

key_terms.التَّقِيَّةِ: precautionary concealment or guarded practice due to circumstances
key_terms.الْفُرَاتَ: the Euphrates River, the place from which the visitor begins this rite
key_terms.ثَوْبَيْكَ الطَّاهِرَيْنِ: your two pure garments to be worn for the visit
key_terms.فَاغْتَسِلْ: perform ghusl (ritual bath) before the visitation

ai.seo_question: What suffices for visiting Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام in a state of taqiyyah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a brief form of ziyārah for Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام in circumstances of taqiyyah. It instructs ritual purification, wearing pure garments, and reciting a concise salutation, indicating that this suffices for the visitation under precautionary conditions.
